Preflight.DistinctReqIdGuarantee: ReqId == _id verified on 1,000 sampled docs; _id is system-unique on all backends, so distinct ReqId == distinct _id == document count even where the ReqId index is non-unique.

Lifecycle.ReconciliationDetail: created=49999 ready=49999 failed=0 closed=49999; tasksStarted=49999 tasksReachedDemand=49999. Expected (one-Task/one-client/no-reuse): created≈closed after drain (delta=0) and created≈Tasks that reached demand (created-demand=0; negative = Tasks that failed at server-selection/open before a connection object was created). Residual active connecting/ready/closing should be ~0 after drain (connecting=0, ready=0, closing=0).

ReuseCheck.Detail: tasks=49999 (successful=49999), created=49999, ready=49999, closed=49999, checkedOut=199996. No-reuse holds when created>=successfulTasks (one fresh connection per completed Task) and created≈closed (no leak). created<successfulTasks is reuse (suspectedReuseEvents=0); created<totalTasks here is 0 Tasks that failed at server-selection BEFORE opening a connection, not reuse. Per-Task pool check-outs (≈4×tasks) are normal within a Task.

TargetTcp.OverheadNote: One GetActiveTcpConnections() table read per raw interval + one process refresh per second; no per-connection retention, no synchronous I/O on workload paths.
